name: Aoi Matsuri procession paid seats
intro: The Aoi Matsuri is one of Kyoto's three great festivals: a procession in Heian-period court dress on May 15. Paid seats along the route give you a reserved view of the procession.

facts.bookAhead: About six weeks: 2026 seats went on sale on April 1

statusNote: The 2026 sale date is from the Kyoto City Tourism Association's official site. The 2027 date is not announced yet; we show the 2026 date as a guide.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: the least searched of the three Kyoto festivals we list.
difficultyNote: Estimate by comparison with the Gion and Jidai Matsuri, where the best seats sold out within weeks; Aoi Matsuri sales have not been tracked yet.
bookingSteps: Check the sale date on the Kyoto City Tourism Association's seat page.
At 10:00 Japan time on sale day, buy online through Ticket Pia's site, linked from the official page.
Choose a regular seat (¥5,000 to ¥6,500) or a Royal seat (¥18,000 to ¥20,000).
For the live commentary in English, bring your own smartphone or tablet with internet access and headphones.
Bring a raincoat and a hat. Umbrellas, parasols and tripods aren't allowed in the seats.
visitorTips: If it rains, the procession moves to May 16. The decision is announced around 18:00 the day before.
Tickets are refunded only if the festival is cancelled, and only where you bought them.
The 2027 sale date has not been announced. We will update this page when it is.

soldOut.label: Watch from the street for free along the route

faq.q: When do Aoi Matsuri seats go on sale?
faq.a: In 2026 they went on sale at 10:00 Japan time on April 1. The 2027 date has not been announced yet.

sources.quote: In case of rain, the procession will be postponed to May 16th.
